newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices gain on thin supply.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices gain on thin supply.

text.p: Indian sugar prices gained on Tuesday on thin supplies and speculative interest though consumer demand was low, dealers said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose by 15 rupees to 1,265/1,295 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved up by 10 rupees to 1,310/1,375 rupees. Sugar mill delivery climbed up from 1,180/1,190 rupees to 1,195/1,205 rupees.

"Overall sentiment was firm at the close and I am expecting sugar prices to move up further in the second half of this month," said Kantilal Dedhiya, secretary of the Bombay Sugar Merchants Association.
